// diagnostic E2813

Jet.FieldErrorPathUnknown

`app.field_error` path `{path}` names no field of an argument.

What

`app.field_error` path `{path}` names no field of an argument.

Why

A field error shows beside the field its path names, so its path walks the fields of a decoded argument, a stored field by name and a list element by `[n]`; any other path is shown beside no field.

Fix

Write `at:` as a literal path through the arguments' fields; at the step that failed it can name {fields}.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.FieldErrorPathUnknown: Tests/UI/web_app_field_error_unknown_path.stderr.

Error: Jet.FieldErrorPathUnknown: `app.field_error` path `asignee` names no field of an argument.

 10 |     Val(app.field_error(at: "asignee", reason: "Pick someone in this project."))
    |                             ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A field error shows beside the field its path names, so its path walks the fields of a decoded argument, a stored field by name and a list element by `[n]`; any other path is shown beside no field.
 Fix: Write `at:` as a literal path through the arguments' fields; at the step that failed it can name `title`, `assignee`.
